text:
nina (Marketing): Quick creative sprint: need a tiny reusable benchmark hero for webinar landing + email header + social tile. Single-sheet, low copy, two messaging lanes (latency-first, cost-first).

raj (Design): ok. sizes + formats? svg + png? mobile crops?

nina (Marketing): desktop 1200x600, mobile 640x360, square 800x800. svg master + png @2x. also a 3-frame GIF for the sparkline.

eddy (Growth): require: 1) brand-only (no CTA) variant for lift tests, 2) transparent PNG for media overlay, 3) copy slate with short CTAs. Audience split: devs (latency) + buyers (cost).

raj (Design): will do 2 layouts: metric-led (big stat + sparkline) and narrative-led (short sentence + supporting stat). two colorways: brand blue and dark invert. modular badge slot for "Dedicated".

sophia (Legal): flag: avoid absolutes like "cheapest" or "always". use qualifiers: "up to" or "on typical workloads". include a tiny methodology footnote/link. I can review short copy fast.

nina (Marketing): copy constraints: headline ~6-9 words, subhead 12-16 words. pull conservative numbers from "Q4-inbound-bench v4". add two headline options per lane.

raj (Design): timeline: first mocks by tomorrow 10:30, review at 11:00, final assets by EOD Wed. deliverables: 2 layouts x 2 headlines x 2 colorways x 3 crops + transparent png + gif + svg animation + README + copy slate.

eddy (Growth): add a variant with no CTAs and one with CTA text only (for ad creative). also want a tiny animated sparkline GIF (320x80) and an SVG micro-animation for landing.

asset-bot: uploaded draft_v1.zip to /Shared/marketing/mini-bench/draft_v1.zip (contains fig, exports, README).

raj (Design): Figma draft: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/mini-bench-hero-drafts 1 org access. export plan: hero-desktop_1200x600.{svg,png}, hero-mobile_640x360.{svg,png}, social_800x800.{svg,png}, sparkline_320x80.gif, copy_slate.txt, README.md.

nina (Marketing): please include two CTAs: "Try the benchmark" and "See pricing & commits". Growth will A/B these. Also add micro-badge variants: "SLA-ready" and "Dedicated option".

sophia (Legal): once final copy posted ping me. I can review in ~1 hour. keep methodology link short e.g., "Methodology: redwood.com/bench-method" and small footnote: "Results on typical workloads; your mileage may vary."

raj (Design): noted. will add the footnote area and ensure typographic scale works at small sizes. GIF will be 3 frames, subtle loop.

eddy (Growth): request: include a plain-text file with exact CTA strings and approved short headlines for ad platform upload. also a 1-line alt text for accessibility.

raj (Design): will include copy_slate.txt with CTAs + alt text. also adding a transparent PNG export for overlays.

asset-bot: mock_v2 package uploaded to /Shared/marketing/mini-bench/mock_v2.zip (includes updated fig, pngs, svg, gif, copy_slate.txt, README).

nina (Marketing): thanks team. scheduling review at 11:00 tomorrow. tagging @raj for noon ping once legal signs off.

raj (Design): will drop final package here after review and legal sign-off. :sparkles:
